seoTitle: How to Add Music to a Canva Website Easily
metaDescription: Embed background music on your live Canva website using the Apps library to add a Spotify, SoundCloud, or custom audio player widget.
intro: Canva websites don't support autoplaying background audio out of the box, but you can still give visitors an interactive way to listen to music through an embedded player. This guide shows how to use Canva's Apps library to add a Spotify, SoundCloud, or custom media player widget to your published site.

steps.heading: Copy your track's share link
steps.body: Grab the public sharing URL for your song or playlist from Spotify, SoundCloud, or another audio host.

steps.heading: Open the Canva Apps library
steps.body: From your active website workspace, navigate to the Apps section in the sidebar.

steps.heading: Use the Embeds tool
steps.body: Launch the built-in Embeds utility and paste your audio track's link into the input field.

steps.heading: Position the audio player widget
steps.body: Resize and place the multimedia player neatly inside your page's grid sections.

steps.heading: Adjust surrounding layout
steps.body: Fine-tune the spacing and margins around the player so it fits naturally with the rest of your design.

steps.heading: Publish and test playback
steps.body: Publish your website and confirm the audio player controls work correctly on the live page.

faq.question: Will the music autoplay when visitors land on my site?
faq.answer: No, embedded audio players require a visitor to click play — Canva websites don't support autoplaying background tracks.

faq.question: Can I upload my own audio file instead of using Spotify?
faq.answer: The Embeds tool is built for linking external audio hosts and streaming platforms rather than uploading raw audio files directly.

faq.question: Will the player look the same on mobile?
faq.answer: The widget resizes with your layout grid, so it's worth previewing your site on mobile to confirm placement looks right.

faq.question: Do I need a Canva Pro plan to embed audio?
faq.answer: The Apps library and Embeds tool are generally accessible on Canva website projects, though feature availability can vary by plan.
